generation.conditioning: Native-f32 split-hue interpolation around automatically identified sharp fold intervals, including negative-hue normalization residual. Generated hue residuals are evaluated at compile time; no runtime widening.

validation.policy_independence: Linear scan of original binary64 table knots, separate linear interpolation and bisection of circle residual; independently derived RGB primaries/XYZ conversion for the mapped output. No production lookup, correction or rationalized arc is used in this reference.
validation.policy_corpus: Grid/random C=0.4 workloads, every LUT knot and adjacent representable hue, wrapped hues -720..+720, L below/at/above cusps and near black/white, negative/zero/near-cusp/high C, RGB cube faces and adjacent OKLCh inputs, every f32 hue in a band around sharp folds, endpoint and extreme-hue finiteness checks.
validation.quality_independence: Stationary-interval first-exit geometry from independent XYZ-derived channel polynomials. This measures a different policy from the LUT/arc mapper; differences are not solver arithmetic error.
validation.quality_corpus: Grid/random workloads, 38 lightness levels per table knot, and 1001 hues by 99 lightness levels in each shared sRGB/Rec.2020 blue-fold window.
validation.canonical: Checked mapping preserves accepted canonical bits separately in each lane. Both lookup variants match bit-for-bit in both modes. Precision-dependent canonical classifications are reported separately by the CLI.

p3_compatibility.manifest: Grid + seeded benchmark random + 32768 mixed inputs and 32768 low-C inputs (mulberry32 0x6d756c74), plus 144 endpoint/extreme-hue inputs; every channel serialized as native bits.

assembly_audit.note: Standalone exported wrappers around the same source. Native fmodf/sincosf/powf calls; no claim about other compilers or architectures.

benchmark.checksum: All three output channels widened and accumulated per sample, passed through black_box before timer stops. Mode dispatch and initialization outside timing.

input_manifest.random: Independent stratified/jittered then shuffled H/L, C=0.4
input_manifest.precision: f64 original inputs; f32 rounded once before timing

benchmark.comparison_scope: Full default P3 harness, same target-cpu=native release/LTO flags and method order, ABBA per mode. No compilation, tests or competing benchmarks ran during timing. Includes code-layout effects.

performance_follow_up: Unchanged P3 prechecked f64 cached cubic regressed +7.9% grid and +3.7% random in this full-harness comparison. Cause not isolated; investigate before closing milestone three. Plain-mode P3 regressions were all below 1.9%.
limitations: Sampled Linux/glibc measurements, not full-domain or cross-platform proofs.
Edge Seeker approximates the boundary: the reported first-exit and clipping differences are meaningful policy/approximation differences, separate from the tighter arithmetic limits.
Exact table regeneration may differ in last bits with other JavaScript engines or math libraries.
Bottosson, cached Bottosson and Dualray remain P3-only.
JavaScript multi-gamut mapping remains milestone four.
